question: Could an agent run your repo without you watching it?

hook_visual.intent: someone asks for work in a repo and the agent takes it from there

points.claim: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
points.spoken: It's dsh-superagent, a research prototype published by DeepSeek: a proactive coding agent for one repository.
points.source_note: README: 'dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness.'

visual.intent: one repository watched by one agent

points.title: A proactive agent

points.claim: It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu; a request for work opens a work item that runs in its own session and directory.
points.spoken: It listens to GitHub, and optionally Feishu. When someone asks for work, it opens a work item in its own session.
points.source_note: README: 'It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory'.

visual.intent: the sources it listens to and the work item it opens

points.title: It takes the work
points.sub: A request becomes a work item.

points.claim: It answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request, and a web panel shows what needs a person.
points.spoken: It answers in the thread where the work was asked, often with a pull request, and a panel shows what needs a person.
points.source_note: README: 'answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.'

visual.intent: the answer landing in the thread, the PR, the panel

points.title: Answers in the thread
points.sub: The panel flags what needs you.

points.claim: It acts only when asked or when a team-written rule allows it, and setup is walked through by your own coding agent from SETUP.md.
points.spoken: It acts only when asked, or when a team rule allows it. Your coding agent walks you through setup.
points.source_note: README: 'it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act'; 'Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.'

visual.intent: the rule that gates action, and the agent-led setup

points.title: Only when asked
points.sub: A team rule can also allow it.

youtube.title: Autonomous coding agent: one repo, run by dsh-superagent
youtube.description: An autonomous coding agent that lives with one GitHub repo: dsh-superagent listens to GitHub and Feishu, opens a work item when someone asks for work, does it in its own session, then answers in the thread with a pull request while a panel flags what needs a person. It is a DeepSeek research prototype, not a product, and it acts only when asked or when a team rule allows it.
